activities.name: Free Coding Bootcamp for Underserved Youth

rationale.intuition: Stanford overall admit rate ~3.7%; RD ~3%。First-gen 是 real hook (admit rate boost ~2-3×)。Stack 上 STEM spike (USACO Gold + Regeneron STS + research + founder service) industry 估计 8-25%。多 hook 应 compound 但 engine 当前 firstGenMultiplier ~1.4 单独不够强 + 现在 geomean fix (PR #285) 又不再 over-inflate marginal academic dimensions。Engine 在 CI seed (anchor 3.7%) 产生 ~2.9%, 在 prod (anchor 3.8%) 产生 ~6.2%。0.025 lower bound = 不能跌到 sub-floor of anchor × 0.7。Upper bound 0.3 documents that industry estimate of stacked hooks is realistic ceiling.

sources.name: Stanford CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 3.68%; first-gen ~17% of class; first-gen admit rate inferred ~7-9%

sources.name: Crimson Hook Stacking Report 2024
sources.evidence: T5 first-gen + STEM spike combo cluster 10-25% admit rate per published cases
